name: Pueblo
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Pueblo for 2026, and here is what he found: 14 family events, 4 of them free. The season starts with the Riverwalk Holiday Lighting Extravaganza on November 27 and the Pueblo Parade of Lights on November 28, then runs through the Pueblo Express Christmas Trains on December 11, 12, 18, 19 and 24, with ElectriCritters at the Pueblo Zoo and the Pueblo West parade along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Pueblo

  • 14 Christmas events for kids in Pueblo
  • 4 free events: the Riverwalk Holiday Lighting Extravaganza, the Pueblo Parade of Lights, the Lucero Library gift giveaway and the Pueblo West Holiday in Lights Parade
  • Trains: Pueblo Express Christmas Trains at the Pueblo Railway Museum, $10 to $15 per ride
  • Meet Santa: at the Riverwalk, ElectriCritters Santa Sundays, the county courthouse lighting and several library parties
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 27, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Pueblo families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Colorado Springs, which covers the Festival of Lights Parade, Electric Safari, The North Pole: Santa's Workshop and more.
